events.description: 21. ORDER ON PENDING MOTIONS - Now before the Court are the following motions: Plaintiff's Motion for Preliminary Injunction [Dkt. 3 ]; Defendant's Motion to Dismiss for Lack of Jurisdiction [Dkt. 17 ]; and Plaintiff's Motion to Remand [Dkt. 20 ]. Plaintiff Jennifer J. Reinoehl, proceeding pro se, brings this action under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 against Defendant Diego Morales, Indiana Secretary of State, challenging "Indiana laws allowing Republicans and Democrats to 's ubstitute' any candidate for another candidate at any time during the election process" on grounds that such statute(s) violate her rights as guaranteed by the First and Fourteenth Amendments to the United States Constitution. For the rea sons explicated above, we GRANT without prejudice Defendant's Motion to Dismiss for Lack of Jurisdiction [Dkt. 17 ] based on standing and DENY Plaintiff's Motion for Preliminary Injunction [Dkt. 3 ]. Plaintiff's Motion to Remand [D kt. 20 ] is also DENIED as this case was originally filed in federal court and we thus lack authority to remand it to state court. Final judgment shall be entered accordingly. Signed by Judge Sarah Evans Barker on 11/4/2024. (See Order.) Copy mailed to Plaintiff. (BAA)
